tasks.title: Fix package name conflict
tasks.description:
The package name com.vireo.app is already taken on Google Play by another app. Change the package name to com.vireoapp.fitness throughout the project:
- android/app/build.gradle: applicationId
- android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml: package attribute
- android/app/src/main/kotlin/... folder name (rename folder from com/vireo/app to com/vireoapp/fitness)
- MainActivity.kt: package declaration
- pubspec.yaml: if package name is referenced
Make sure all references are consistent.

tasks.title: Verify ads initialize correctly
tasks.description: In lib/main.dart or app initialization, confirm MobileAds.instance.initialize() is called before any ad is loaded. Add it if missing.

after_all_tasks: Run flutter analyze — must be 0 errors
